run_label: GATE-A cortex array ownership — private arrays, incumbent parity, double-count control

build.reason: /home/sungwook/ffn_ac_native is not a git repository; the commit is the caller's assertion and was not verified here

evidence_basis: the cortex owner allocated component-private position/force arrays of exactly its own node count, launched the real ff bending + crosslink kernels on CUDA over them, and its force field matched the incumbent's cortex assembly node-by-node; NOT CONNECTED — no connector was dispatched inside an accepted-step transaction and no two-sided resultant was closed

config.parity_tolerance_source: COMPARTMENT_VALIDATION_TRACKS_2026-07-25.md T2 pass criterion, written before this run
config.incumbent_compartments: myosin/steric/nucleus/membrane/pressure OFF for the parity arm

channels_not_bound.axial_inextensibility: NF2007 constraint carried by the solver, not an accumulated force — binding a spring here would double-count the backbone
channels_not_bound.steric_wca: the WCA neighbour search addresses every solid node in the cell, not just the cortex; it belongs to the composed world
channels_not_bound.biot_pressure: -alpha*grad(p)*V is a field->solid coupling owned by the cytosol component and delivered through surface_porous_transfer, not a cortex-internal channel

provenance.geometry_provenance: CONVENIENCE (coarse/percolation), not sourced — seg_um and length_um sit above the sourced cortical mesh and filament lengths and density_per_fil has no sourced value (PARAM_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_2026-07-24.md)
provenance.force_channels: cytosim bending + Hookean crosslink (+ Arp2/3 branch angle when mixed)
provenance.not_a_channel: axial inextensibility is an NF2007 solver constraint, not an accumulated force — a spring here would double-count it

census.population_note: native is 70,686 filaments; a slice develops the instrument and never supports a conclusion

timing.device_note: NOT a benchmark: the wall-clock covers two (or three) full cell builds plus kernel compilation, and this gate runs no time steps at all — it is a static force-assembly comparison, so there is no converged-step cost to report
timing.comparable_against: another run whose gate also PASSED under the same contract and observable; a cost is only a cost at a stated convergence

detector_control.what: a known constant force added to a COPY of the incumbent's actin-block force

myosin_arm.what: incumbent rebuilt with myosin ON; how much of that reaches an ACTIN node
myosin_arm.why: every head is UNBOUND at rest (the resting bound-myosin setpoint is a PI-GAP and defaults OFF), so the minifilament's backbone/head-arm forces land on myosin particles at indices >= n_actin and no myosin force reaches an actin node
myosin_arm.not_a_control: because it is zero, this arm cannot detect a foreign force; the device-side double-count control needs _accumulate_all(omit=), which is PI-gated (TRACKS 6 D2)

channels_not_bound.axial_inextensibility: NF2007 constraint carried by the solver, not an accumulated force — binding a spring here would double-count the backbone
channels_not_bound.steric_wca: the WCA neighbour search addresses every solid node in the cell, not just the cortex; it belongs to the composed world
channels_not_bound.biot_pressure: -alpha*grad(p)*V is a field->solid coupling owned by the cytosol component and delivered through surface_porous_transfer, not a cortex-internal channel

gate.void_ceiling_rationale: a relative force difference above 1e-6 cannot be float64 atomic arrival order on a network of this size, so the run would be comparing two models rather than one model with itself, and the parity number would not be interpretable as a refactor check
